sloka: पपात चरणौ तस्यास्तदा सम्भ्रान्तचेतनः ।विलप्य बहुधाऽसम्ज्ञो लब्धसम्ज्ञ्स्ततः स्थितः ॥२-७५-१८॥
transliteration: papāta caraṇau tasyāstadā sambhrāntacetanaḥ ।vilapya bahudhā'samjño labdhasamjñstataḥ sthitaḥ ॥2-75-18॥

translations.english: (Having heard these words), his senses reeling, he became unconscious, lamented profusaly and fell at her feet. And on regaining his senses, he stood motionless.
